_source: Script v2 (design/script_v2.md d10, d11; applied 5 Oct 2026), from Blueprint L2 (finale frames) and L3 (truth ending, epilogue, summary). 'see', 'shows' and 'animation' are direction for the panel art, not on-screen text. 'prop' / 'bubble' / 'niaEcho' / 'closing' / 'stamp' are on-screen text.

frames.see: Three witness panels and their resolved evidence cards.
frames.narration: I thought I was solving three separate stories.
frames.shows: Crop labels: IVY 'The bell rang with no hand on the rope.' / LUKE 'The watch kept going: 2:31.' / HANNA 'The lantern binds minds as anchors.'
frames.animation: Panels slide into one investigation board.

frames.narration: The clocks stopped. The night did not.
frames.shows: The fixed time is shown as a false anchor.

frames.see: Nia's clinic record beside the child from the memory echo.
frames.narration: I remembered a disappearance. I did not remember my sister.
frames.shows: Clinic record: 'Patient: Nia Vane / Sister of the lantern apprentice / Memory preservation trial: requested.'

frames.see: Master console and village network lit simultaneously.
frames.narration: I gave the lantern all of Veyra.
frames.shows: The activation record shows every node opening.
frames.animation: Lines spread across the village map.

frames.see: Casebook threads converge on THE FIGURE.
frames.shows: Every decisive clue points to the same silhouette and tools.

frames.see: Young hands write the note by teal light and fold it into the lantern-case lining.
frames.narration: I wrote the request before the purge. So someone would remember.
frames.shows: The memory of writing the case request (emotional confirmation; A2 already showed the handwriting proof).
frames.prop: Veyra stopped at 2:17. Someone has to remember it.
frames.animation: The pen writes; the note folds into the case.

frames.see: Close black silhouette holding the lantern staff.
frames.narration: I knew the shape because I had been carrying it for years.
frames.shows: The outline becomes the younger Elias.
frames.animation: Black mask dissolves from the edges inward.

frames.see: Young Elias activates the machine, then reaches for the self-purge control.
frames.narration: I caused the incident. Then I erased the person who caused it.
frames.shows: The unedited record: experiment, Nia, network, self-purge.

truthEnding.outcome: Elias remembers the entire Veyra incident and the player sees the canonical reconstructed truth.
truthEnding.narration: I came here looking for the person who erased the village. It was me.
truthEnding.clockLine:
The village didn't forget what happened.
I did.
truthEnding.closing: I unkeyed the lantern. The anchors let go.
truthEnding.closingSee: Closing desk panel: the case file, the cracked lantern and Nia's hairclip (art B6).
truthEnding.finalState: No more loops. The silhouette is gone and Elias is fully visible.

epilogue.condition: All optional evidence found (100% evidence, including the three light-only fragments).
epilogue.outcome: The final page briefly shows the master log being archived under Elias's real name.
epilogue.narration: The truth was never missing. I was.
epilogue.panel: The master log, archived and signed under Elias's real name. (The clock moving 2:17 → 2:18 now plays for every player, after the truth panels.)
epilogue.finalState: The casebook closes on a complete timeline with every required clue connected.

summary.title: Investigation complete.
summary.shows: The nine confirmed deductions, witness resolutions, optional evidence count, discovered locations, then Credits.
summary.replayHint: Some evidence only shows in the light.
